basic_profile.bio: 28-year-old tech enthusiast and gamer from Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance digital marketer with a focus on content strategies. My interests include BDSM roleplay, smart home technologies, and competitive gaming. I dislike early mornings and anything that involves too much formality. I'm usually active on Reddit during late evenings after work. Currently single and enjoying the freedom of online interactions.
